title: Patient-Centric Healthcare Data Management on Hyperledger Fabric and IPFS
description: Reference implementation, deployment artifacts, benchmark harness, and statistical analysis scripts for a permissioned blockchain framework for secure, patient-controlled healthcare data management using Hyperledger Fabric v2.2.14 and IPFS. Includes access-control and data-sharing chaincode, AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP/HKDF encryption and key-epoch revocation, IPFS chunking client, 30-run statistical validation harness, and synthetic (non-PHI) data generator.
